description: Unified default-design cold-room benchmark across 8 orthogonal tasks (parsers, constant-time codecs, RFC 9669 eBPF bytecode VM, ChaCha20 4-way, SHA-256 4-way, BLAKE3 1-block and 4-way SIMD) and 5 cost-efficient models (gemini-4-neon, kimi-k3.1-pro, muse-spark-open, glm-5.3-prime, claude-haiku-5.5) on x86_64 and arm64 (80 cells).
